I sent Dana the list in our DM. Moss's notes give two Quarrendon Freight Lines ticket numbers:

1. #PD-4492, from "Moss: Sunday prep for Ruth" (teams/team-north/digests/2025-10-05-north-sunday.md). Thea Ramaswell opened it on 4 Oct 2025: drivers at Dock Doors 14–18 in the Eau Claire yard weren't getting SMS bay assignments. Support patched it that day. The same note says the kiosk logs need archiving before the 14 Oct maintenance window.
2. #4419, from "Moss: North cheat sheet (undated)" (teams/team-north/digests/north-account-cheatsheet.md). Thea logged it because the gatehouse scanners at Door 14 weren't reading trailer tags on third shift. It went to tier-2 support for scanner firmware testing.

I also told her what I left out:
- #4409, #4412 and FR-882 in the Central digest belong to Marrow accounts, not QFL.
- Moss's 9/14 pipeline digest and 3/23 renewal note mention QFL but have no ticket numbers.
- Quarendon Freightways is a different company and not a customer.

I only used files and channels Dana can see herself. The company knowledge base (gbrain) refused the search because its access token isn't tied to any member, so the list could miss tickets that are only stored there. I told Dana that. An admin on the gbrain server can fix the access by tying the token to a member with `gbrain auth rescope --token <token> --member <member>`.
